title: Account Manager | Campinas
description:
Quem somos?

Somos uma empresa de cibersegurança orientada a viabilizar as estratégias de negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções seguras, flexíveis e inovadoras.

Atuamos no Brasil desde 1998, integrando soluções de última geração reconhecidas pelo Gartner, Forrester e pelos nossos clientes.

Descrição do cargo:

Como Comercial de Cybersecurity, você será responsável por identificar, desenvolver e gerenciar oportunidades de negócios na área de cibersegurança. Seu papel será fundamental para impulsionar as vendas de soluções de segurança cibernética, construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e prospects, e garantir que as necessidades de segurança sejam atendidas de forma eficaz. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e externas para oferecer soluções que protejam os ativos e dados dos clientes contra ameaças cibernéticas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócios na área de cibersegurança.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas para alcançar metas de receita e expansão de mercado.
  • Manter um pipeline robusto de oportunidades de vendas e conduzir negociações com prospects.
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e prospects, entendendo suas necessidades de segurança e oferecendo soluções personalizadas.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto de contato para questões relacionadas a cibersegurança, oferecendo suporte e consultoria ao longo do ciclo de vendas.
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de pré-venda e consultoria para entender os requisitos técnicos dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas.
  • Apresentar e demonstrar soluções de cibersegurança, destacando os benefícios e o valor agregado das soluções.
  • Analisar o mercado e as tendências de cibersegurança para identificar novas oportunidades e ajustar estratégias de vendas.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing para desenvolver campanhas e materiais de suporte às vendas.
  • Monitorar o progresso das vendas e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de vendas e previsões para a liderança, fornecendo insights sobre desempenho e áreas de melhoria.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas de soluções de cibersegurança ou em um papel comercial semelhante.
  • Conhecimento sólido de conceitos e práticas de cibersegurança, incluindo ameaças, vulnerabilidades e soluções de proteção.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação excepcionais, com capacidade para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara e acessível.
  • Experiência em gestão de relacionamentos com clientes e desenvolvimento de negócios.
  • Certificações relevantes em cibersegurança (CISSP, CEH, etc.) são um diferencial.
  • Morar em São Paulo

A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Junto com suas empresas irmãs, a Swarovski Optik (dispositivos ópticos) e a Tyrolit (abrasivos), a Swarovski Crystal Business compõe o Swarovski Group. Uma relação saudável com as pessoas e com o planeta é parte da herança da Swarovski. Hoje, esse legado se fundamenta em medidas de sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor, com ênfase na inovação circular, defendendo a diversidade, inclusão e autoexpressão, e no trabalho filantrópico da Swarovski Foundation, que apoia organizações de caridade que provocam um impacto ambiental e social positivo.

Swarovski é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades. Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. Todos os aspectos do emprego, incluindo a decisão de contratar, promover, disciplinar ou demitir, serão baseados no mérito, competência, desempenho e necessidades do negócio. title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Overview

About Sierra Studio

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

About our hiring partner

Our hiring partner is a consumer product development company. They help companies make new products & bring them to market, leading concepting, design, engineering, supply chain setup & ongoing operational oversight. They have teams in New York City, Hong Kong and beyond. They work with startups and established companies across many consumer categories; from connected hardware & electronics, to durable housewares and in-home goods, to soft-goods and packaging, and everything in between.

Who our hiring partner is looking for

They are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling, prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer will be a member of our hiring partner's Brazil team - The position can be remote but will report to the Staff Engineer out of Campinas/SP. The Brazil team reports into the Head of Product based in HQ in NYC.

The Candidate

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on challenges.

The Job

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

Responsibilities

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components. Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

The Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • High level proficiency in English language- written and spoken

Working Hours

While our work involves coordination predominantly with NY Team, there are meetings that are scheduled outside of traditional 9-6 working hours to accommodate the HK team. We trust all team members to manage their schedules and to take appropriate measures to take care of themselves and their wellbeing.

The Process

Please submit your resume and we will reach out if there is a potential fit.

Our hiring partner is constantly refining their hiring process to be as inclusive, transparent, and respectful of applicants' time as possible. As part of this process, you may be asked to complete a paid assessment based on the role.

Our hiring partner is an equal opportunity employer. They are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. They firmly believe that a diversity of experience, perspectives, and background lead to a better environment for their employees and to better results for their clients. They strongly encourage diverse candidates to apply.

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. Toradex’s Brazil office hosts parts of the Global Sales, Marketing, and R&D teams, composed of several engineers working on diverse tasks with global reach. Toradex teams are mission-oriented, high-performing collaborative, and empowered to innovate & improve products & services (including open-source projects) for the benefit of our customers and the industry.

As an Embedded System Developer in the Developer Experience team, you will work to accelerate the time-to-market of our customers through the provision of technical support, the production of technical documentation, and the creation of demonstrations and proofs-of-concept.   • Make complex technical concepts easy to understand for Toradex target customers
  • Being a key stakeholder in the overall user experience of Toradex products
  • Interact with customers using our support channels (email, community, documentation)

Requirements

  • Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.
  • Availability to work from the Toradex Office in Campinas/SP at least 4 days a week
  • Detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability and passion to learn new technologies, and develop skills in embedded software and hardware.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team-oriented environment.
  • Good Novel Problem-Solving Skills
  • Experience and knowledge as a user or system administrator
  • Experience with Embedded Linux or with a Linux Development
  • Developed Applications for Embedded Linux Devices
  • Knowledge of common interfaces and how to use them on the software side, such as:
    • GPIO, I2C, SPI, UART, MIPI-CSI, LVDS and more.

  • Able to read and comprehend hardware schematics
  • Knowledge of programming patterns and anti-patterns
  • Programming languages
    • C/C++

  • Knowledge of at least one Shell Scripting Language, such as Bash or Perl
  • Strong proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Previous exposure to the developer community
  • Previous experience or courses working with Yocto
  • Familiarity with Docker containers
  • Experience with CI/CD
  • Knowledge of Agile development concepts
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, preferably on embedded devices
  • Designed a working PCB from scratch either professionally or as a hobby
  • Passion and skill to communicate about products and technical concepts in webinars, blogs, and talks

What we Offer:

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development

Desired Candidate Profile:

Toradex is providing and dynamic, fun and exciting work environment. We are looking for somebody who has similar values, is passionate about his work, and is motivated to learn new things. We try to constantly improve and expect the same from you.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user-centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision-making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium-to-large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user-centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code

title: Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer
description:
Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Description

As an Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer BSP, you are part of the R&D team, making sure our Linux BSPs and related software offerings for our SoMs (System on Modules) are constantly developed, maintained, and quality improved. The work ranges from initial bring-up, to driver and kernel development, up to build-system, tooling and distro level development.

  • Develop and maintain Embedded Linux BSPs for Toradex' embedded computer modules
  • Eco-system: porting of third party software libraries, develop Software tools and utilities from scratch, Boot loader firmware
  • Mainline selected items
  • Suggest improvements related to products, software offerings, documentation, processes, etc. in order to allow continuous improvement
  • Work closely with other team members in an Agile development environment and participate in technical analysis and decisions
  • Communicate your work progress, coordinate with other development teams, and participate in R&D working groups

Skills

  • Expertise in Embedded Linux: Bootloader and Linux Kernel
  • Excellent C language knowledge and programming skills
  • Knowing OpenEmbedded/Yocto Project build system
  • Knowledge of industry standard interfaces and protocols such as I2C , SPI , UART , USB, Ethernet, PCI Express
  • C++/Python/Bash language knowledge and programming skills
  • Demonstrable Electronics knowledge and work experience: the ability to read and understand hardware schematics and datasheets; to use standard development aids such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus protocol analyzers, etc. when developing low-level software which interacts directly with machine registers
  • Familiar with communication peripherals (Bluetooth, Ethernet, Wi-Fi)
  • High-integrity, open, team player

Plus but NOT MANDATORY:

  • Experience with Real Time Operating systems
  • Knowledge of the ARM architecture

What do we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and inter-cultural corporate culture.
  • Flexible working set up. Working remotely possible (within European time zone)
  • Work on the latest HW technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our HW and SW offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced HW and SW engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Todradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Overview

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

The Matthews Group is a 18 person group within Marex, started by Craig Matthews 35+ years ago. We have a very strong name in the agriculture brokerage space all around the world, and service clients across most all jurisdictions.

  • To escalate risk events immediately

Skills and Experience

Conduct Rules

Company Values

Respect – Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity – Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Adaptable and Nimble – Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non-bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check and psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • Submit your CV in English, as this is the main language used at InPlanet (Portuguese accepted if justified).

Being an equal opportunity employer, InPlanet does not discriminate on grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We design our processes to be fair and equitable and believe in continuous learning.

title: VCP- Operador de Equipamentos
description:
Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

Job Description
Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.
O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.
Requirements And Qualifications
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
Additional information
Estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos, então faça o seu cadastro e venha fazer parte do time dnata Brasil!
Líder mundial em fornecer serviços aéreos!
Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, atendendo as principais companhias aéreas nacionais e internacionais que operam no país, sempre 100% dedicados em cumprir nossas funções com ética, qualidade, expertise e excelência.

DESCRIÇÃO
Dentista Avaliador(a) (Banco de Talentos)

Você é dentista, ama cuidar de pessoas, mas também vibra com metas, desafios e realizações?

Então vem com a gente transformar sorrisos e resultados!

Na Odontoclinic, procuramos Dentistas Avaliadores(as) com olhar clínico e espírito comercial. Profissionais que sabem encantar no atendimento e têm paixão por entregar experiências únicas e gerar valor em cada conversa com o paciente.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e com alto astral
  • Treinamentos constantes e ferramentas para o seu desenvolvimento
  • Reconhecimento por desempenho e oportunidades reais de crescimento
  • Remuneração atrativa com base em meritocracia
  • Propósito: transformar a vida das pessoas através do sorriso!

  • Formação em Odontologia com CRO ativo

  • Facilidade para construir conexão e gerar confiança com o paciente
  • Capacidade de apresentar planos de tratamento de forma clara e estratégica
  • Energia, foco em metas e atitude de dono(a)
  • Vivência com vendas será um diferencial, mas vontade de aprender conta muito!

Suas Principais Missões

  • Realizar avaliações iniciais com excelência e atenção genuína
  • Apresentar planos de tratamento alinhados às necessidades do paciente
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com a equipe para atingir metas e gerar encantamento
  • Ser um elo entre o cuidado clínico e o sucesso do paciente na jornada odontológica

Se você acredita que excelência clínica e performance podem andar juntas, essa é a sua chance de fazer parte de algo grandioso.

Vem ser Odontocliniquer e crescer com a gente!

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos.

Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso só é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, colecionamos conquistas como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e o reconhecimento como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Também fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui — um reflexo direto da nossa paixão por servir e do compromisso com a qualidade em cada detalhe.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Upstream Bioprocess Scale-up Engineer Specialist
description:
Overview

Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.

Role Description

Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an exceptional upstream bioprocess engineer for to scale-up of emerging technologies in the area of bio-based chemicals via fermentation processes. The candidate will work closely with the fermentation development team and have primary responsibility for commercial process design, ensuring technical risks are addressed and mitigated in the scale-up from lab to pilot/demo phases. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in fermentation scale-up with experience in implementation of new technology at industrial scale and comfort working closely with innovative teams from research and development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synthesize the upstream conceptual process design for fermentation-based technologies emerging from discovery teams in lab. This includes all steps from feed preparation, seed train, and fermentation sections of the flowsheet.
  • Work closely with the fermentation development team to guide experimental work with a view toward the commercial process design, and ensure relevant technical targets are set based on commercial process economics.
  • Guide the planning of the pilot plant testing program according to the conceptualized commercial design to ensure the key risks are mapped and mitigate as the technology progresses through scale-up.
  • Build strong relationships while working closely with the firms operating or constructing the pilot plant fermentation units.
  • Generate the technology transfer package in collaboration with the fermentation development team for upstream section of the bioprocess. Serve as the fermentation process expert during pilot and demo testing, being present onsite for extended campaigns.
  • Support process safety reviews for emerging technologies.
  • Own responsibility as the expert on the process technology and key deliverables of the Process Design Package PDP that will be the basis for commercial design and engineering or toll manufacturing.

Additional Responsibilities and Activities

  • Identify and evaluate innovative and disruptive technologies through interaction with technology licensors, participation in events associated with bio-based chemical technologies, and review of international publications.

  • Contribuir diretamente para o aumento da produtividade e da assertividade dos engenheiros, através da criação e implementação de padrões, procedimentos e ferramentas de engenharia.

  • Otimizar o tempo de execução das tarefas de engenharia, permitindo que os engenheiros se concentrem em atividades de maior valor agregado.

  • Graduação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Química, de Alimentos, de Produção, ou áreas correlatas).

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de engenharia, preferencialmente em indústrias de alimentos, bebidas, farmacêutica ou química.

description:
Analista de Suporte - Folha de Pagamento

Analista de Folha de Pagamento (área Suporte)

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira dentro da área Contábil e Fiscal em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!

A Thomson Reuters combina a inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões confiantes e administrar melhor seus negócios. Nós os ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, nossa equipe de especialistas reúne informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comércio Exterior, contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.

Sobre a Posição

Nesta oportunidade, como Analista de Suporte - Folha de Pagamento , você será responsável por oferecer um atendimento técnico de excelência aos clientes que utilizam os módulos de Folha de Pagamento do sistema Domínio. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Prestar suporte funcional via telefone, garantindo um atendimento claro, empático e eficiente.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas e orientar os clientes com assertividade, promovendo uma experiência positiva.
  • Atuar com foco na resolução de problemas e na melhoria contínua do serviço prestado.
  • Compreender a jornada do cliente e direcioná-lo conforme suas necessidades específicas.
  • Intermediar solicitações de ajustes e correções junto às equipes de Produto.
  • Promover os valores e comportamentos da Thomson Reuters no dia a dia.
  • Manter-se constantemente atualizado sobre as soluções oferecidas e a legislação vigente na área de Folha de Pagamento.

Sobre Você

Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as Habilidades & Experiência:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Candidatos sem graduação também são bem-vindos — caso aprovados no processo seletivo, serão contratados como Técnicos.
  • Experiência com Atendimento ao Cliente.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com metas e foco em resultados.
  • Adaptabilidade a processos estruturados e rotinas organizadas.
  • Boa comunicação, empatia e habilidade para atuar em equipe.

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia na área de Folha de Pagamento.
  • Experiência prévia com a Solução Domínio.

O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível (2-3 dias por semana no escritório, dependendo do papel) para funções baseadas em escritório.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: políticas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, com possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, programa Grow My Way e foco em habilidades para crescer e prosperar com IA.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: planos de benefícios que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e bem-estar.
  • Cultura e Inclusão: valorização de inclusão, pertencimento, flexibilidade e equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal, com foco em nossos valores.
  • Impacto Social: oportunidades de voluntariado remunerado e iniciativas ESG através do Instituto de Impacto Social.
  • Missão e Propósito: atuação para promover justiça, verdade e transparência, contribuindo para o estado de direito e o comércio global.

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com dados, inteligência e soluções para decisões informadas. A Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial em jornalismo e notícias confiáveis. Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, buscando objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência. Oferecemos acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiências e para crenças religiosas, conforme a lei. Para mais informações, acesse thomsonreuters.com.

title: ANALISTA DE MARKETING
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Minerva Foods é a maior exportadora de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália e no Chile, somando mais de 30 mil colaboradores. A empresa atende a cinco continentes com carne bovina, ovina e seus derivados e opera, hoje, 46 unidades industriais, 17 escritórios internacionais e 23 centros de distribuição.

A Sua Missão Será

Apoiar a área de Marcas Globais no mercado nacional na execução do plano estratégico e operacional, agregando valor ao portfólio afim de criar marcas fortes para expandir os negócios e maximizar resultados financeiros da empresa.

Papéis e Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver materiais de marcas e de produtos para mercado nacional.
  • Colaborar com planejamento e execução de campanhas de comunicação.
  • Suportar a área de Trade com criações de campanhas específicas e ativações em clientes.
  • Planejar e executar ativações das marcas de produtos: parcerias, eventos.
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e execução do plano estratégico de marcas com driver de crescimento para as categorias do portfólio bovino, cordeiros e industrializados dentro do mercado nacional.
  • Suportar a área com informações e análises relevantes sobre a categoria, utilizando diferentes fontes de dados e ferramentas.
  • Apoiar projetos de Inovação e Lançamento de produtos (pesquisas, projetos, calendário, go to market, alinhamentos com times P&D, trade marketing e comercial e KPIs pós lançamento).
  • Suportar gestão de portfólio com análises e recomendações para as categorias, contribuindo com insights para o atingimento dos objetivos definidos e que garantam participação de mercado e posicionamento correto de nossas marcas e produtos.
  • Realizar estudos de mercado e tendências, visando a possibilidade de novos negócios e extensão portfólio atual.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia em comunicação e marketing, preferencialmente dentro do setor de alimentos ou bens de consumo. Habilidades analítica e de comunicação verbal e escrita, com bom relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de interpretar dados e extrair insights significativos.

title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as a liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate the completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP-based interfaces using IBM and third-party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

description:
Na Pearson, nosso propósito é simples: ajudar as pessoas a realizarem a vida que imaginam por meio da aprendizagem. Acreditamos que toda oportunidade de aprendizado é uma chance de transformação pessoal. Somos a empresa de aprendizado ao longo da vida mais reconhecida do mundo. Para nós, aprender não é apenas o que fazemos. É quem somos.

Para saber mais:

Nossa Equipe: O time de Planejamento Estratégico tem como missão transformar dados e análises em decisões que impulsionem o crescimento da empresa. Atua de forma transversal com diversas áreas, estruturando metas, indicadores e processos comerciais para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e foco em resultados. É um ambiente dinâmico, analítico e desafiador, ideal para quem busca aprender com profundidade sobre o negócio, ter impacto direto nas decisões da empresa e que tenha autonomia e visão estratégica. O time antecipa cenários, fortalece a conexão entre estratégia e execução e garante o alinhamento da operação comercial aos objetivos da companhia. É um ambiente dinâmico, analítico e colaborativo, ideal para quem gosta de entender o negócio em profundidade, conectar estratégia e execução e gerar impacto real por meio de análises financeiras e comerciais.

Aqui valorizamos pessoas curiosas, com pensamento crítico e vontade de aprender continuamente, que se sintam motivadas por desafios e pela oportunidade de contribuir com decisões estratégicas do negócio.

Sobre a Função

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para integrar nosso time de Planejamento Estratégico. Se você é apaixonado(a) por análise de dados, estratégia e finanças, e possui sólida experiência em transformar informações em direcionamentos práticos para o negócio, esta posição é para você. Aqui, você terá papel fundamental na conexão entre resultados comerciais e financeiros , atuando como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) da liderança. Além de apoiar na definição de metas e estratégias comerciais, esperamos que este(a) profissional tenha profundo entendimento de P&L (DRE) , saiba avaliar impacto de receitas, custos e despesas, e contribua ativamente para o aumento da rentabilidade e da margem do negócio .

A posição exige alta capacidade analítica, visão crítica de negócio, habilidade de comunicação e forte capacidade de articulação com áreas diversas.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Analisar performance comercial e financeira, conectando indicadores de receita, custos, despesas e margem.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de modelagens financeiras e projeções que embasem decisões estratégicas e campanhas comerciais.
  • Acompanhar e interpretar o P&L (DRE), identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria de resultado.
  • Apoiar na definição e monitoramento de metas comerciais, garantindo coerência entre objetivos, capacidade operacional e rentabilidade.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento e acompanhamento de campanhas de vendas (Sell In e Sell Out).
  • Estruturar relatórios e dashboards com visões financeiras e comerciais, garantindo clareza e precisão nas informações.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado e concorrência, traduzindo análises em aprendizados aplicáveis ao negócio.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e automação de processos da área de planejamento.

Para dar match com essa vaga, é importante que você tenha:

  • Fit com a cultura Pearson.
  • Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Estatística, Contabilidade ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento comercial, controladoria ou inteligência de mercado .
  • Boa compreensão de P&L (DRE) , incluindo análise de receitas, custos, despesas e margem.
  • Vivência com modelagens financeiras e simulação de cenários .
  • Conhecimento em indicadores comerciais (captação, conversão, ticket médio, churn, etc.).
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e visualização com ferramentas como Excel avançado, Power BI, Python ou Google Looker Studio .
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para conduzir apresentações executivas e influenciar decisões junto à liderança.
  • Perfil organizado, proativo, com senso crítico, foco em resultado e trabalho colaborativo.
